name: engineering-board
description: The board is the database: a git-committed kanban board your AI agents run and remember — distributed as a Claude Code plugin and an MCP server.

plugins.name: engineering-board
plugins.description: Git-committed pattern intelligence for engineering agents. Transparent cluster ranking, durable H### root-cause hypotheses, and rejected-claim memory connect recurring findings across domains while Markdown remains canonical. Includes passive capture, stable P### identities, atomic claims, and a zero-dependency 17-tool MCP server over the same board format.
